focus: The empty cassette swings to take chain load. Inspect the upper crosspiece, panel and flap. A gated hook, positive hold and load-rated shoulder remain open.
notes: Windowed polycarbonate panel alone: 0.314 kg at planning density, 4.2 mm above the seated NOTE. The cover arrests outward lift but leaves an open exit along the bed. A passive flap is a separate mechanism.

Two posts connect the climb crosspiece to the cassette beams. At the 68.56 kg comparison load the peak static torque from robot weight alone is 171.2 N·m. These are geometric screens before purchasing a drive, brake and actual hook.
The shared-lift mass and current figures are allocations. Eight CG corners were screened; loaded chain movement and intermediate CG values remain open.
